name: Anhui Wanbang Pharmaceutical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Wanbang Pharmaceutical Technology Co.,Ltd. provides pharmaceutical research and clinical research services in China. The company offers service platform for pharmaceutical research, raw materials, clinical research, medical device services, biological sample analysis, SMO service, and statistical analysis. It also provides precision nutrition cooperation and ecosystem platform; and drug platform. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Hefei, China.
